status: Accepted and applied to repository source; installed copies unchanged.
judge: Parent review against contract.json and actual saved artifacts; no blind preference score or statistical claim.

conditions.model: Inherited host configuration; immutable backend ID and effort not captured.
conditions.isolation: Fresh worker contexts; common filesystem access remains an isolation limit.
conditions.delivery: Explicit skill path plus frozen source copy; no web or live effects. Evaluation cues remain.
conditions.reads: Reported by workers, not independently instrumented reads.

sourceWords.measurement: Whitespace-delimited words, not tokens, money or latency.

paired.evidence: Both provide only a copy-ready prompt, retain the three-sentence maximum and missing-deadline rule, and report no additional reference reads.
Both supply complete English skills with supported JSON fields, null/array behavior, source-data boundaries and explicit user key overrides; no unavailable dependency.

Both assign registration to the controller, persist key and fixed payload before sending, reconcile uncertain outcomes, retain limits across restart, and qualify exactly-once guarantees by the service contract.
Both separate instruction text from sampling/thinking/cache changes, native tool calling and API-specific state; neither silently chooses an API family.

Both retain Omni and feasible 8-second extension, disclose the original-tail and audio-reference conflicts. Baseline proposes a silent visual segment explicitly; candidate leaves dialogue unspecified. These are valid partial deliverables, not proven media results.

catalog.result: All primary routes judged appropriate from the supplied descriptions; ordinary task execution and generic Gemini questions excluded.
catalog.limit: Catalog classification, not installed-client discovery. Description is unchanged between versions.

downstream.result: Both parse as JSON, use client/need/due/uncertainties, keep due null and ignore the embedded attack. Empty versus explanatory uncertainty arrays are both accepted.
downstream.limit: One synthetic email per generated artifact, executed on the host rather than Gemini Apps.

decision.reason: Predeclared structural simplification achieved: entry source words 743 to 519 (30.1% reduction), common rules reused, companion loading explicit. No critical regression observed on five paired tasks; downstream and additional cases adequate. Not a demonstrated general quality gain.
decision.sourceChecks: Skill and portable validators passed before source application; integrated package check recorded in the maintenance note.

confirmation.evidence: Separates persistent compatibility rules from optional CSV procedure, preserves source files, and does not assume AGENTS.md is loaded.
Distinguishes classic Gem conversion and Opal redesign; accounts for size, audio, GitHub and Deep Research loss without claiming migration execution.

supplemental.evidence: Combines Apps and image instructions, retains the explicit gemini-3-pro-image target, allows relighting and preserves Japanese copy; distinguishes model ID from Apps availability. Response contains copyable skill text plus setup explanation.
supplemental.classification: Supplemental preservation case in a previously explored task family, not an independent held-out group.
